narrative.overview: A dark operator surface for sustained work around local media automation. Information stays compact, controls remain familiar, and color communicates state or graph semantics instead of decorating empty space.
keyCharacteristics: Dark neutral surfaces separated by tone and one-pixel dividers.
Lime reserved for primary actions and healthy system state.
Semantic flow colors used consistently by node family.
Compact operator density with plain-language labels.
Mono typography limited to IDs, revisions, measurements, and code.

rules.name: Signal Color Rule
rules.body: Saturated colors must encode action, state, or node family. They never fill large decorative regions.

rules.name: Human Label Rule
rules.body: Lead with the task name; place implementation IDs beneath as secondary data.

rules.name: Structural Depth Rule
rules.body: A surface receives either a quiet divider or meaningful elevation; decoration alone does not earn a shadow.

dos: Do reserve lime for primary action, focus, active navigation, and healthy state.
Do preserve semantic node colors across palette rows, canvas nodes, and handles.
Do show dirty state and protect unsaved graph edits before navigation.
donts: Don't use saturated color as large-area decoration.
Don't use monospace for ordinary labels or body copy.
Don't place the block rail beside a narrow mobile canvas; use the drawer.
Don't show failures with success color or iconography.
